**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The RENEWAL rule targets evergreen renewal risk, and this agreement has none. Article VIII contains only optional acquisition/clean-up redemption (8.1), optional redemption (8.2), and a self-executing termination in 8.3 tied to the last Receivable being paid/settled/sold/written off or termination of the Issuer under the Trust Agreement. Document-wide searches for "renew," "renewal," "automatically renew," "initial term," and "extended term" returned no hits, so there is no renewal term, no non-renewal notice window to compute, and no renewal price-uplift language to cap.

Because the agreement cannot roll over absent a fresh amendment, it effectively sits at (or above) the preferred position of "renewal only by mutual written agreement," and the Article VII servicer resignation/termination and successor-servicer mechanics give the Issuer exit rights independent of any renewal cycle. Marking this "missing" would be incorrect: the rule's expected clause has no place in a securitization transfer and servicing agreement, and grafting a 30-day opt-out with a CPI/3% cap onto this structure would be inapposite.
